description: This Go source file contains test cases and helper functions for testing Kubernetes admission webhooks, including validating and mutating webhooks, with various scenarios such as error handling, dry run support, reinvocation policies, and annotations. It defines test case structures, utility functions for creating webhook configurations, and sample test cases for different webhook behaviors.

classes.name: FakeAttributes
classes.description: A wrapper around admission.Attributes to add annotation tracking for testing purposes.

classes.description: Structure representing a validating webhook test case with expected outcomes.

classes.description: Structure representing a mutating webhook test case with expected outcomes.

classes.name: DurationTest
classes.description: Structure for testing webhook duration metrics.
